title: Rangoon
desc: Julia journeys to the Indo-Burma border to perform for the troops during World War II, on the insistence of Billimoria, her lover. There, she finds herself enamoured by Jemadar Malik, a soldier.

title: Sweetheart!
desc: An animator struggles with commitment issues when his girlfriend reveals that she is pregnant. His emotional journey unfolds with surprising humor, leading to personal growth and self-discovery.

title: Hyper
desc: Suryanarayana Murthy is protective of his father, who is an honest government officer. However, when a politician causes trouble for his father, Surya strives to protect him.

title: IPC 376
desc: A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.

title: Saivam
desc: When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.

title: Raja Raja Dhan
desc: Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.

title: Khiladi Doss
desc: Dasu unwittingly becomes embroiled in an illegal drug lord's nefarious operations. However, he soon catches wind of what's going on and decides to retaliate.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thegidi
desc: Vetri, a criminology student, joins a private detective agency and is tasked with gathering information on three people. However, his subjects mysteriously begin to die one by one.

title: Maanagaram
desc: Upon moving to Chennai, four lives get intertwined as they strive to achieve success in the city. However, when a vicious gangster threatens them, the group must work together to defeat him.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Kullanari Koottam
desc: Vetri, an unemployed young man, meets Priya and falls in love with her, but faces challenges when her father wants him to join the police force.

title: Aamaa Part 2
desc: Mohini and Harsha relocate to a different city to escape the haunting of an evil spirit only to later realize that the spirit is still hot on their trail.
